offers_products.reason: Sells AI knowledge management and customer service automation software (AI Knowledge Hub, AI Agent) as SaaS.

offers_services.reason: Offers implementation help and pilots, but the main offering is the software platform.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are enterprises and government, such as banks, telcos, airlines and insurers, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to enterprises and government agencies in banking, healthcare, telco, retail and insurance.

recurring_revenue.reason: Per-user and per-resolution SaaS pricing means subscription-style ongoing revenue from contact center customers.

cyclical_demand.reason: Customer service knowledge software is embedded in operations and cost-saving, so it is not easily cut in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Sold as subscriptions priced per user or per resolution, not as large one-off purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for the software platform and AI technology, not for staff time.

large_customers.reason: Positioned for enterprise and government customers such as airlines, banks, telcos and insurers.

asset_heavy.reason: Cloud software business needs no plants, fleets or property to grow.
